extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio uses the microphone only after you start Live Voice, for continuous speech recognition and barge-in.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio uses the camera only after you start Live Perception, for visible and cancellable neural observation.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio captures a screen only after you select it for visible and cancellable neural observation.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio sends keyboard input only when a brain action is permitted and visible in the action trace.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio uses system speech recognition only while Live Voice is active; unavailable recognizers are never simulated.
